method: Read-vetted modules with independently constructed synthetic bytes. Git inventory lookup is replaced by explicit pinned-tree metadata; no Git objects, historical source or provider accessed.

checks.limits: The mocked lookup returns metadata for different bytes; all source/copy SHA256 and trusted manifest pin agree. Demonstrates absent bridge, not an incorrect real Git executable.
Inventory pin is recomputed for synthetic input. No bypass of an independently fixed external pin.

pytest.scope: Three fully read synthetic-only test modules, no conftest or plugin autoload; temp files confined to this review prefix.

runtime.scope: Focused checks on available workspace interpreter; not reproduction of the declared Python3.12 runtime profile.
